per_episode.instruction: Grab the red can, drop it in the basket with rounded edges, and lift the basket with rounded edges.
Use the left arm to set the red can with white top in the medium-sized basket with perforated texture; another arm lifts the medium-sized basket with perforated texture.
Use the left arm to place the rounded can with smooth printed surface in the basket with rounded edges; the other arm lifts the basket with rounded edges.
Grab the rounded can with smooth printed surface, put it in the yellow basket with open slots, lift the yellow basket with open slots.
Grab the lightweight cylindrical metal can and put it in the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, then lift the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.
